intro: The Falafel Crunch Bowl from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) is a Mediterranean masterpiece featuring crispy falafel, fluffy saffron basmati rice, and signature toppings. At $13.45 to $14.45, this vegetarian-friendly bowl delivers 860 calories of authentic flavors with creamy hummus, tangy Crazy Feta, and crunchy pita crisps. Perfect for those seeking a satisfying plant-based meal from the [full CAVA menu](/), this bowl combines traditional ingredients with bold textures.
priceCalories: Priced between $13.45 and $14.45, the Falafel Crunch Bowl provides 860 calories with 24g of protein, 88g of carbs, and 56g of fat. This mid-range option from the curated bowls collection offers excellent value for a complete meal. The calorie count makes it suitable for lunch or dinner, providing substantial energy and nutrition. Regional pricing variations may apply at different [CAVA Locations](/locations) across the country.
whatMakesSpecial: This bowl stands out with its signature combination of crispy falafel and crunchy pita crisps, creating multiple texture layers. The Crazy Feta adds a bold, tangy element while saffron basmati rice provides an aromatic base. Lemon Herb Tahini dressing ties everything together with bright, herbaceous notes. Unlike basic falafel bowls, this curated option balances traditional Mediterranean ingredients with CAVA's innovative toppings for maximum flavor impact.
nutritionFacts: With 860 calories per serving, the Falafel Crunch Bowl delivers 24g of protein for muscle support and satiety. The 88g of carbohydrates provide sustained energy from quality sources like saffron rice and chickpea-based falafel. At 56g of fat, primarily from healthy sources like tahini, hummus, and feta, this bowl offers balanced macronutrients. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for detailed customization options.
whatsInside: This bowl features crispy falafel as the protein, saffron basmati rice as the base, and creamy hummus from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads). Crazy Feta adds tangy richness while fresh tomato and cucumber provide crisp vegetables. Crunchy pita crisps deliver satisfying texture, and Lemon Herb Tahini dressing from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/dressings) adds bright, zesty finish. Each ingredient complements the others for a harmonious Mediterranean experience.
tasteLike: Expect a flavor journey starting with crispy, herb-infused falafel paired with fragrant saffron rice. The creamy hummus and tangy Crazy Feta provide rich, savory notes while fresh tomatoes and cucumbers add refreshing brightness. Crunchy pita crisps deliver satisfying texture contrast, and the Lemon Herb Tahini brings everything together with citrusy, garlicky goodness. The overall profile is Mediterranean-forward with bold, balanced flavors and multiple textural elements.
customize: Customize your Falafel Crunch Bowl by swapping the saffron rice for options from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like SuperGreens or Black Lentils. Add extra protein from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) or switch up toppings using the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings). Adjust dressing portions, add extra vegetables, or increase the falafel quantity. Create your perfect bowl by modifying heat levels or adding sides for a complete meal.
pairsWell: This bowl pairs excellently with items from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) like Classic or Spicy Pita for extra scooping. Add a refreshing beverage from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) to balance the rich flavors. For dessert, try options from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts). The Falafel Crunch Bowl also complements lighter options when sharing, making it perfect for group dining experiences.
healthyChoice: The Falafel Crunch Bowl offers a vegetarian protein source through chickpea-based falafel and provides essential nutrients from fresh vegetables. With 24g of protein, it supports muscle maintenance and keeps you satisfied. The healthy fats from tahini, hummus, and feta support nutrient absorption. While the 860-calorie count is substantial, the balanced macros make it a nutritious choice. Consult the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary considerations.
howToOrder: Order the Falafel Crunch Bowl in-store by requesting it from the curated bowls section or through the CAVA app for convenient pickup. Specify any customizations when ordering, such as extra falafel or dressing on the side. The bowl comes fully assembled with all standard ingredients included. For dietary needs, reference the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) and inform staff of any modifications needed before preparation begins.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Chicken + Rice Bowl at 700 calories ($12.85-$13.45), the Falafel Crunch Bowl offers a vegetarian alternative with more calories and fat. The Greek Salad Bowl (580 cal, $12.85-$13.45) provides a lighter option. The Harissa Avocado Bowl (830 cal, $13.95-$14.95) delivers similar calories with different flavor profiles. The Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl (800 cal, $14.95-$16.25) offers meat protein at a higher price point.
whoShouldTry: Vegetarians seeking satisfying Mediterranean flavors will love this bowl's plant-based protein and diverse toppings. Falafel enthusiasts appreciate the crispy preparation and complementary ingredients. Those exploring the curated bowls menu who want a pre-designed option without customization stress should try this. Anyone seeking balanced macros with substantial calories for an active lifestyle will find this bowl fulfilling. First-time CAVA visitors wanting a classic Mediterranean experience should consider this signature option.
worthTrying: The Falafel Crunch Bowl absolutely deserves a try for its expertly balanced flavors and satisfying texture contrasts. At $13.45 to $14.45, it offers excellent value for a complete, protein-rich meal. The combination of crispy falafel, creamy dips, fresh vegetables, and crunchy pita creates a memorable eating experience. Whether you are vegetarian or simply love Mediterranean cuisine, this curated bowl showcases CAVA's ingredient quality and flavor expertise perfectly.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the CAVA Falafel Crunch Bowl?
faqs.a: The Falafel Crunch Bowl contains 860 calories with 24g protein, 88g carbs, and 56g fat. This makes it a substantial meal option suitable for lunch or dinner with balanced macronutrients from quality Mediterranean ingredients.

faqs.q: What comes in the Falafel Crunch Bowl at CAVA?
faqs.a: The bowl includes crispy falafel, saffron basmati rice, hummus, Crazy Feta, fresh tomato and cucumber, crunchy pita crisps, and Lemon Herb Tahini dressing. All ingredients are carefully selected to create balanced Mediterranean flavors with multiple textures.

faqs.q: How much does the Falafel Crunch Bowl cost?
faqs.a: The Falafel Crunch Bowl is priced between $13.45 and $14.45, depending on location and size options. This mid-range pricing reflects the quality ingredients and generous portion size that makes it a filling, complete meal.

faqs.q: Is the Falafel Crunch Bowl vegetarian or vegan?
faqs.a: The Falafel Crunch Bowl is vegetarian but not vegan due to the Crazy Feta cheese. To make it vegan, request no feta when ordering. The falafel, hummus, tahini, and vegetables are all plant-based ingredients suitable for vegan diets.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Falafel Crunch Bowl?
faqs.a: Yes, you can fully customize the Falafel Crunch Bowl by changing the base, adding or removing toppings, adjusting protein portions, or selecting different dressings. CAVA encourages customization to match your dietary preferences and taste preferences for a personalized meal.
